snippet.title: 1001 Crosswords for the Nintendo DS
snippet.description: 1001 Crosswords is the first DS crossword game to include over 1000 puzzles, featuring a combination of Quick and Cryptic crosswords from the UK's leading national newspapers. Produced by Wired Productions.
